name: vbase
description: Turn one raw talking-head take into an edited video inside Claude Code: word-timed cuts, captions, 3D objects tracked to your hands, camera moves, a clone of you, a launch-style open and end card, and a review room for notes.

interface.shortDescription: Raw take in, edited video out: a Claude Code plugin that edits talking-head videos.
interface.longDescription: VBASE turns one raw talking-head take into an edited video inside Claude Code. It cuts between words using WhisperX timings and Silero VAD, adds word-by-word captions, camera moves, 3D graphics and an open and end card, and masters the audio to -14 LUFS. Every take opens in a local review room where you pin notes on exact frames; each note reaches Claude with its time, frame, position in the picture and a snapshot, and Claude answers it in the next take. Everything runs locally and no paid API is required.
